content.user_title: Trace OpenSpec Changes to Verified Closure
content.value_statement: OpenSpec tasks and archive states do not prove evidence-backed completion. This skill maps requirements, acceptance items, journeys, and gates into an auditable RVTF closure process.
actual_capabilities: Map OpenSpec requirements and scenarios to stable RVTF Requirements and Acceptance Items.
Evaluate whether scenarios require Journey applicability, ordered steps, and outcome evidence.
Define standalone or split-host execution authority without creating dual lifecycle control.
Specify source digest checks, target-specific evidence claims, and gap handling.
Structure a formal completion preflight across OpenSpec, RVTF, and implementation gates.
limitations: It does not execute OpenSpec or RVTF commands.
It supports one repo-local Change with the built-in spec-driven schema in version one.
It does not support Stores, custom schemas, cross-root planning, or bulk archive workflows.
It cannot treat checked tasks, verification output, sync, or archive as closure evidence by themselves.

use_cases.title: Audit a planned Change
use_cases.description: Map requirements, scenarios, tasks, and acceptance evidence before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Review implementation readiness
use_cases.description: Check source bindings, execution authority, mandatory gates, and evidence gaps before applying a Change.

use_cases.title: Prepare a closure decision
use_cases.description: Assess target-specific claims, Journey paths, findings, gaps, and final validation before declaring completion.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Map a Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply RVTF traceability to this OpenSpec Change. Identify its requirements, scenarios, tasks, acceptance items, and missing mappings.

prompt_templates.title: Basic: Check Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this OpenSpec Change for implementation readiness. Confirm the supported root and schema, sidecar requirements, task mappings, Journey applicability, and mandatory gates.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Audit Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the Change evidence claim by claim. Reconcile source digest changes, separate Item evidence from Journey path evidence, preserve valid claims, and list exact gaps with owners.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Decide Closure
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a formal RVTF closure assessment for this OpenSpec Change. Verify host authority, source bindings, requirements, acceptance items, applicable Journeys, gates, findings, review state, Closure Packet fields, and final CLI validation.

output_examples.input: All OpenSpec tasks are checked, but one mapped Acceptance Item has no target-specific evidence.
output_examples.output: Keep the host progress, keep the affected Item implemented, and record an evidence gap with its owner. Do not close the Change.

output_examples.input: The Change was archived before the RVTF disposition was complete.
output_examples.output: Record the archived host state, preserve the prior RVTF disposition, and identify the continuation owner and entry condition.

output_examples.input: A source file digest changed after the trace projection was created.
output_examples.output: Reject the old projection for closure, reconcile stable IDs and mappings, assess affected evidence, and preserve only explicitly validated claims.

best_practices: Keep OpenSpec as authored truth and RVTF as the evidence and closure layer.
Use separate target-specific claims when one artifact supports multiple Requirements, Items, or Journeys.
Record exact gaps, owners, and entry conditions whenever a gate or evidence requirement is unsatisfied.
anti_patterns: Treating checked tasks, a clear verification report, sync, or archive as proof of RVTF closure.
Reinterpreting a custom schema or Store as the supported repo-local spec-driven workflow.
Allowing OpenSpec and a split-host method to schedule work or own lifecycle state simultaneously.

faq.question: What does this skill trace?
faq.answer: It traces one OpenSpec Change from authored requirements and scenarios to RVTF evidence, gates, review, and closure.

faq.question: Does a checked task prove completion?
faq.answer: No. Checked tasks may support implemented status, but they do not produce verified evidence or complete RVTF closure.

faq.question: When is a Scenario also a Journey?
faq.answer: Only when an actor, goal, and observable multi-step path require ordered path or outcome evidence.

faq.question: What happens when source text changes?
faq.answer: The prior projection is rejected for closure until digests, stable IDs, mappings, and affected evidence are reconciled.

faq.question: Can this skill support a custom OpenSpec schema?
faq.answer: No. Version one supports one repo-local Change using the built-in spec-driven schema.

faq.question: Does the skill run validation commands?
faq.answer: No. It defines the required preflight and validation evidence; the host environment must run the commands and provide their results.
